description: Lists the team's clients (end members) with membership status, join date and activity. Use when the user wants to find a client, see who is active, suspended or inactive, or who needs attention (insight_status). Not for team staff or coaches (manage those in Teams). Returns names, client IDs, membership IDs and paging; email is in the data to tell clients apart.

include_stats.description: Add last activity, completed sessions and completion rate per client. Defaults to true; set false for a faster list.

insight_status.description: Keep only clients in this coaching bucket: on_track = training as planned; watch = slipping; act = needs a coach now. Needs client insights in the team plan.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

search.description: Text to match in client names or emails, e.g. "ana". Omit to list everyone.

sort.description: Order: joined = join date (default); name = A to Z; status = active first; insight_status = Act first, then Watch, then On track.

sort_direction.description: asc = oldest or A first (default); desc = newest or Z first.

status.description: Membership filter: active = can use the app; suspended = paused by the team; removed = removed by the team; left = left on their own; all = every client. Omit for all.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_clients
title: List clients
